sections.heading: What we build
sections.items_heading: Here's what we build to spec:
items: Management systems (CRM, ERP, invoicing) built for your actual workflow
Point of sale systems that work offline, with real inventory and role-based access
Internal tools for whatever no off-the-shelf software solves
sections.outro: See the detail on each: <link1>management systems</link1> or <link2>point of sale</link2>.

sections.heading: Why custom
sections.body: A lot of agencies sell 'custom software' as a generic pitch on their homepage, without showing you anything real running. We build and use our own tools — like <link1>miPost</link1>, our point of sale system, which runs in real stores today — so we know what it takes to keep a system running in production, not just sell it.

faq.q: What kind of software can I request?
faq.a: Management systems, point of sale platforms, internal tools, or specific integrations — if your business needs it and no off-the-shelf SaaS fits, we'll scope it.

faq.q: How much does a custom system cost?
faq.a: It depends on scope. As a reference, our point of sale system miPost has a one-time license fee of $100 USD — for other systems, we quote based on what you need.

faq.q: Do you have something pre-built, or do you start from scratch every time?
faq.a: We start from your actual need. Sometimes there are reusable pieces from past projects (like miPost's modules), but the final system is built around you, not the other way around.

cta.heading: Got a process no off-the-shelf software solves?
cta.body: Tell us how your business runs today and we'll tell you if a custom build makes sense.

meta.title: Custom Point of Sale System Development | Hyper Grid Studio
meta.description: We build custom point of sale systems that work offline: real-time inventory, role-based access, and no monthly fees. See miPost, our real case study.

software_pos.h1: Custom point of sale systems that don't need the internet to work
software_pos.intro: No monthly subscription, no lost sales when the wifi drops. We build point of sale systems that run offline, with real inventory control and role-based access — built around how your business actually runs, not the other way around.

sections.heading: The problem
sections.body: Off-the-shelf POS platforms charge you a monthly fee for features you'll never use, stop working the moment your internet drops, and can't be bent to fit anything specific to your business — a one-off discount, a bundle, a report you actually need. You end up adapting your business to the software instead of the other way around.

sections.heading: The solution
sections.body: We build your point of sale system to the exact scope your business needs — the modules you use, nothing you don't. It runs on the store's own machine, works fully offline, and you own it outright: pay once, no subscription.
items: Sales reports and stats (built to catch a bad entry before it becomes a real problem)
Custom modules built around your specific business

sections.heading: Case study: miPost
sections.body: We built miPost, a point of sale system for small retail stores (kiosco-style shops) with full inventory control, in one intensive week of development. It's still in active use today, running in real stores — including licensed installs for Guillermo González and Mónica Pérez — each on a single device license.
sections.items_heading: What sets it apart from a generic POS
items: Works with zero internet dependency. Licensing is validated fully offline (Ed25519, tied to the machine), so the store never stops selling because the connection dropped.
8 modules and 3 permission tiers, so owners see everything and cashiers only see what they need to.
Saves the owner from chasing down bad sales entries — every sale is logged with a clear, reviewable detail.
One-time license fee of $100 USD, no subscription.

sections.heading: Why custom
sections.body: Square or Shopify POS solve the generic case, but you pay forever and the system doesn't bend to how you actually work. A custom system is a one-time cost, it's yours, and it grows with new modules only when you actually need them — not as an upsell on a subscription tier.
sections.outro: Need more than a point of sale? If you're looking to automate bookings or WhatsApp follow-ups, check out our <link1>automation services</link1>. And if you need a full management system beyond the register, see our <link2>management systems</link2>.

faq.q: Does the system work without an internet connection?
faq.a: Yes. It's built to run independently of your connection — you can keep selling and tracking inventory even if the store's internet goes down.

faq.q: Can I give employees different permission levels than the owner?
faq.a: Yes, the system supports role-based access (e.g. owner, manager, cashier) with different levels of visibility and control.

faq.q: How much does a custom point of sale system cost?
faq.a: It depends on scope and the modules you need. As a reference point, miPost (retail + inventory) has a one-time license fee of $100 USD. For a custom system in a different business type, we quote based on what you actually need.
It depends on scope — miPost itself was built in one intensive week. We'll scope it in the first call and give you a real timeline.

cta.heading: Need a point of sale system that works your way?
cta.body: Tell us how your business runs today and we'll tell you exactly what modules you need — no fluff.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Hyper Grid Studio we respect your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it and what your rights are.
privacy.s1_body: When you fill out the contact form we collect your full name, email address and message. We do not collect any other personal data through the website.
privacy.s2_body: The data is used solely to respond to your inquiry. We do not use it to send advertising or unsolicited communications.
privacy.s3_body: We do not sell or share your information. Form messages are processed through Formspree. You can review their policy at formspree.io.
privacy.s4_body: This site does not use cookies or tracking technologies.
privacy.wa_intro: We offer Aliz, an assistant that lets you book appointments through WhatsApp. When you interact with our WhatsApp bot, the conditions described below apply.
privacy.wa_data_body: When you message the WhatsApp bot we collect: your phone number, your WhatsApp contact name, the content of the messages you send to the bot and the booking details you schedule (date and time).
privacy.wa_use_title: What we use that data for
privacy.wa_use_body: We use this data solely to manage appointment booking for the corresponding client business. It is not used for any other purpose.
privacy.wa_proc_body: Your data is processed through the Meta WhatsApp Business API (to send and receive messages), the Google Calendar API (to register the appointment in the business calendar) and the Anthropic (Claude) API (to interpret your booking request expressed in natural language).
privacy.wa_share_title: We do not share your data
privacy.wa_share_body: We do not sell or share your data with third parties beyond the service providers mentioned, which are strictly necessary for the bot to operate.
privacy.wa_retention_title: How long we keep the data
privacy.wa_retention_body: We keep conversation and appointment data for a maximum of 12 months, or until you request its deletion, whichever comes first.
privacy.wa_deletion_title: How to request deletion of your data
privacy.wa_deletion_body: You can request the deletion of your data at any time by writing to <mail></mail>. We will process your request promptly.
privacy.s6_body: The site has an SSL certificate (HTTPS); all information travels encrypted and securely.
privacy.s7_body: You can request access to or deletion of your data by writing to <mail></mail>.
privacy.s8_body: For any questions about this policy, write to <mail></mail>.
